who.value: Buyer who has placed an order

job.value: Check order status and complete payment before the deadline

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Order details' with 'Pending payment — Make payment by 2:34pm using PayNow QR' says what the order needs.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal button is 'View payment guide', not a way to pay; the payment itself (the QR) isn't visible on the first screen.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'View payment guide', 'Copy' and 'View profile' each say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'PayNow QR' and 'Express delivery' are familiar to SG buyers.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decisions asked; the buyer just needs to pay.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Payment steps are behind 'View payment guide'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Status, delivery details and item all belong to fulfilment.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The status title, deadline and button carry it.
